note: Canonical marker genes for interpreting mean cluster expression. Cluster identities are NOT given directly and must be inferred from these markers.
malignancy_rule: A cluster is malignant epithelium if it is epithelial-marker positive (mean EPCAM and KRT8 both well above baseline) AND shows a high proliferation-to-tumor-suppressor ratio (elevated MKI67 relative to TP53), consistent with uncontrolled proliferation and loss of tumor-suppressor function.
